title: AI-Assisted Search
description:
Converts a natural language prompt into an Intel Exchange search query.

### Changelog

Added a new endpoint for AI-assisted search in Threat Data.

body.name: prompt
body.description: Pass the natural language query to convert into a search filter.
body.value: Show IPv4 objects with risk score greater than 80 created in the last week

body.name: timezone_offset
body.description: Pass the timezone offset in minutes from UTC. For example, pass -330 for IST (UTC+5:30).

body.name: query
body.description: Returns the generated search query in Intel Exchange filter syntax.
